case_title: BIHARI LAL v. THE STATE OF RAJASTHAN & ORS.
trial_court_outcome: Discharged from offence under s.307 IPC
neutral_facts: The accused persons were prosecuted for commission of offences punishable under Sections 307, 323, 325, 336, and 341 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code. The accused argued that no offence under Section 307 IPC was made out against them and that no charge should have been framed under that section. They referred to and relied on two medical reports filed by the prosecution. The trial court accepted their argument and discharged them from the offence under Section 307 IPC, proceeding to frame charges in relation to other offences. The complainant filed a criminal revision before the High Court, which dismissed the revision. The Supreme Court held that both courts below wrongly appreciated the medical reports and concluded that no prima facie case was made out against the accused under Section 307 IPC. The Court directed the trial court to frame the charge under Section 307 IPC against the accused.
